sources.title: Apodex | Self-Evolving Heavy-Duty Solver
sources.snippet: To research, solve, and discover at the frontier requires more than model capacity — it requires rigorous reasoning, each step verified. Apodex is an AI system designed for complex and demanding research tasks. It structurally splits the reasoning solver from the verifier to deliver grounded, auditable intelligence across three distinct capability tiers.

sources.title: Apodex | Self-Evolving Heavy-Duty Solver
sources.snippet: The hardest problems are heavy-duty and have no existing answer. Apodex does the deep research to find one, and checks every step so you can trust the result.
